title: The Enemy Lucian Needs

audience_goal.summary: Fantasy romance viewers who enjoy dangerous supernatural relationships
audience_goal.success_metric: Sustain romantic tension, mystery and survival pressure

commercial_goal.summary: Create a sequel-driving enemies-to-allies supernatural episode

story_goal: Create a supernatural romance about two enemies who discover they need each other to survive.

creative_brief.hook: Vampire enemies learn that a lethal threat can only be survived together.
creative_brief.pacing: fast survival pressure with escalating reluctant dependence
creative_brief.target_emotion: mystery to fear to conflicted attraction
asset_constraints: Keep supernatural violence non-graphic and platform-safe.
generation_notes: Lucian is a vampire and a principal character.
Lucian appears cold, protective, and secretive.
Lucian desires to protect his world.
Lucian believes humans cannot understand monsters.
Lucian needs human connection but rejects humans.
Lucian and an unnamed human enemy must depend on each other to survive.
Do not rename Lucian or change his vampire identity.
